chapter.title: The People Who Make Organizations Go–or Stop

sourceTitle: Teamwork — The People Who Make Organizations Go–or Stop
articleTitle: The People Who Make Organizations Go–or Stop

items.meaning: 无固定形态的，组织边界模糊的
items.definitionEn: Having no clearly defined shape or structure.
items.usage: 用于网络时，指它没有固定的成员边界或组织形式。
items.exampleEn: An amorphous network of volunteers formed around the neighborhood project.
items.exampleZh: 这个社区项目逐渐形成了一个组织结构不固定的志愿者网络。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 公认却几乎不言而喻的说法
items.definitionEn: A statement regarded as so obviously true that it adds little new insight.
items.usage: 语气常含“这是大家都知道的常识”。
items.exampleEn: It is a truism that trust takes time to build.
items.exampleZh: 信任需要时间建立，这是个不言而喻的道理。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 总是，一贯如此
items.definitionEn: In every case or with very few exceptions.
items.usage: 描述稳定重复的行为，语气比 often 强。
items.exampleEn: When a shipment goes missing, the warehouse team invariably calls Priya first.
items.exampleZh: 一旦有货物丢失，仓库团队总是先联系普里娅。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 使失去信誉或支持
items.definitionEn: To make others doubt the credibility or value of someone or something.
items.usage: 宾语可为人、证据、政策或提案。本文指利用关系削弱他人对项目的信任。
items.exampleEn: The division head used an isolated mistake to discredit the entire proposal.
items.exampleZh: 部门负责人利用一次孤立的失误使整个提案失去支持。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 错综复杂的
items.definitionEn: Having many parts that are connected in a complicated way.
items.usage: 侧重内部细节或关系交错。
items.exampleEn: The handover exposed an intricate web of dependencies between the teams.
items.exampleZh: 交接暴露出各团队之间错综复杂的依赖关系。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 可以用某种方式处理或管理的
items.definitionEn: Capable of being dealt with by a particular method.
items.usage: 事物作主语时常接 analysis、measurement 或 treatment。人作主语时可以指愿意接受建议。
items.exampleEn: The new intake process is amenable to automation because every request follows the same format.
items.exampleZh: 新的受理流程适合自动化，因为每个请求的格式都相同。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 在其他方法不够用时转而依靠
items.definitionEn: To rely on someone or something as a backup when better options are unavailable.
items.usage: 强调退回到备用办法。文章里指缺乏可用的网络数据时诉诸直觉。
items.exampleEn: When the dashboard went offline, we fell back on a manual checklist.
items.exampleZh: 仪表板离线后，我们转而使用手工检查清单。
collocations: fall back on a backup plan

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 社会资本，人际关系带来的可用资源
items.definitionEn: Access to support, information, or cooperation through social relationships.
items.usage: 重点是关系网络中可以调动的信任、信息与合作。
items.exampleEn: Her social capital helped her find reviewers across three departments in a day.
items.exampleZh: 借助平时积累的人际关系，她一天内就在三个部门找到了审阅者。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 中心联络人，非正式网络中的联系枢纽
items.definitionEn: A person whom many members of an informal network approach for information or connections.
items.usage: 多为同一网络中众人直接联系的对象，有时也可能成为信息瓶颈。
items.exampleEn: The lab technician became a central connector because researchers regularly asked her who had the equipment they needed.
items.exampleZh: 研究人员常问这位实验技术员谁有他们需要的设备，她因此成了联络枢纽。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 跨界联络人，连接本网络与外部群体的人
items.definitionEn: A person who connects a network with people in other units or organizations.
items.usage: 强调跨越当前网络的边界，可以连接同公司不同部门，也可以连接外部机构。
items.exampleEn: A designer with long-standing supplier contacts acted as a boundary spanner for the product team.
items.exampleZh: 一位长期与供应商保持联系的设计师为产品团队承担了跨界联络的工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 信息中介，连接同一网络内原本分隔的子群
items.definitionEn: A person who carries information between otherwise weakly connected subgroups.
items.usage: 直接联系人未必很多，价值在于把原本联系很少的小群体接起来。
items.exampleEn: The project coordinator became an information broker between the regional support groups.
items.exampleZh: 项目协调员成了各地区支持小组之间的信息中介。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 分裂成若干较小的群体或部分
items.definitionEn: To break up into smaller, separate groups or parts.
items.usage: 常用于团队、政党或联盟因内部割裂而分成小团体。
items.exampleEn: Once the coordinators left, the volunteer network splintered into three isolated groups.
items.exampleZh: 协调员离开后，志愿者网络分裂成三个彼此隔绝的小组。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 外围专家，联系不密集但能按需提供专长的人
items.definitionEn: A person at the edge of a network whose specialized knowledge is valuable when needed.
items.usage: “外围”描述关系位置，专家对组织仍可能十分重要。
items.exampleEn: The acoustics engineer was a peripheral specialist whom the team consulted only on noise problems.
items.exampleZh: 这位声学工程师是团队的外围专家，大家遇到噪声问题时才会找他。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 拥有并施展影响力、权力或权威
items.definitionEn: To exercise influence, power, or authority.
items.usage: 这里是抽象义，常见宾语为 influence、power 或 authority。
items.exampleEn: The scheduling coordinator wielded considerable influence over which projects started first.
items.exampleZh: 排期协调员对哪些项目先启动有相当大的影响力。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 直觉判断，凭感觉形成的判断
items.definitionEn: A judgment based on instinct rather than detailed evidence.
items.usage: 较口语，常见于比较直觉与数据的语境。gut feeling 是常见变体。
items.exampleEn: His gut feel was that demand would rise, but the sales records suggested otherwise.
items.exampleZh: 他凭直觉认为需求会上升，但销售记录显示情况可能不同。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 使现有问题恶化，加剧
items.definitionEn: To make an existing problem or difficult condition worse.
items.usage: 常接 conflict、inequality、delays 等已经存在的不利情况。
items.exampleEn: Routing every approval through one person exacerbated the delays.
items.exampleZh: 所有审批都经过同一个人，加剧了延误。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 社会网络分析，对关系结构进行系统分析
items.definitionEn: The systematic analysis of relationships and patterns of connection among people or groups.
items.usage: 在文中可用问卷了解员工向谁求助，再把关系画成网络图并结合访谈解释。
items.exampleEn: Social network analysis showed which employees were repeatedly asked to troubleshoot customer issues.
items.exampleZh: 社会网络分析显示了哪些员工经常被请去处理客户问题。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 囤积、扣住不愿分享
items.definitionEn: To keep more of something than needed, or keep it to oneself instead of sharing it.
items.usage: 以 information 为宾语时，往往暗示掌握信息的人不愿让别人获得。
items.exampleEn: The account manager hoarded customer updates to protect his influence over the project.
items.exampleZh: 客户经理扣住客户的最新消息，以维持自己对项目的影响力。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 首选求助对象，遇事首先想到的人
items.definitionEn: A person who is usually approached first for a particular need or problem.
items.usage: go-to 作前置形容词，表示一遇到某类问题就优先考虑的人或资源。人可以用 go-to person，资源可以用 go-to resource。
items.exampleEn: After the launch, Mei became our go-to person for billing problems.
items.exampleZh: 上线后，梅成了我们遇到计费问题时首先求助的人。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 磨炼技能，改进工具或方法使其更精确
items.definitionEn: To improve a skill or method through practice and refinement.
items.usage: 文章中宾语是分析工具，强调逐步改进。也常见于 hone a skill。
items.exampleEn: We honed our interview protocol after running three pilot sessions.
items.exampleZh: 三次试访后，我们进一步完善了访谈流程。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已有 hone，原词卡主要讲磨炼技能。本篇补充改进工具或方法使之更精确的用法。

items.meaning: 用力过猛，超出实际需要
items.definitionEn: An approach that uses more effort or resources than the situation warrants.
items.usage: 非正式表达，常用 be overkill 判断某个办法是否过度。
items.exampleEn: A full company-wide survey would be overkill for a question affecting only two teams.
items.exampleZh: 这个问题只涉及两个团队，做全公司调查就有点用力过猛了。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 更不用说，遑论
items.definitionEn: Used after a negative statement to introduce an even less likely or more demanding possibility.
items.usage: 常放在否定或表示困难的分句后，后面的内容比前面的更进一步。
items.exampleEn: We could barely meet the internal deadline, let alone finish a public launch.
items.exampleZh: 我们连内部截止日期都差点赶不上，更不用说完成公开发布了。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 即时奖励，针对具体贡献迅速给出的奖励
items.definitionEn: A reward given promptly to recognize a particular contribution.
items.usage: spot 在这里强调当时或很快发放，常见于对具体行为的及时认可。
items.exampleEn: The firm gave a spot reward to the engineer who solved the customer outage.
items.exampleZh: 公司给解决了客户服务中断问题的工程师发了一笔即时奖励。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 超出通常职责或预期
items.definitionEn: Beyond what is normally required or expected.
items.usage: 常用 go above and beyond；也可以作奖励名称的一部分。
items.exampleEn: The support team went above and beyond to restore service over the weekend.
items.exampleZh: 支持团队周末额外付出了很多努力来恢复服务。
collocations: above and beyond the call of duty

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 交叉核对，用另一来源或方法验证
items.definitionEn: To check information against another source or method for accuracy.
items.usage: 常用 cross-check A against B，强调不同证据互相检验。
items.exampleEn: We cross-checked the interview notes against the team’s incident logs.
items.exampleZh: 我们用团队的事故日志交叉核对了访谈记录。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 瓶颈，使信息或工作流转变慢的环节
items.definitionEn: A person, step, or constraint that limits the flow of work or information.
items.usage: 常见问题是多人都必须等待同一个人的回复或批准。
items.exampleEn: Having one reviewer for every request created a bottleneck.
items.exampleZh: 所有申请只交给一名审阅员，造成了审批瓶颈。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 取代，使原先的人或事物失去原有位置
items.definitionEn: To take the place of someone or something previously established.
items.usage: 比 replace 更正式，常用于一种做法或角色逐渐占据原先的位置。
items.exampleEn: The shared ticket system gradually supplanted informal requests over email.
items.exampleZh: 共享工单系统逐渐取代了邮件里的非正式请求。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.originalInput: pitting two subsets of the informal network against each other
items.meaning: 使双方对立或相互竞争
items.definitionEn: To place two people or groups in opposition or competition.
items.usage: 完整搭配是 pit A against B。文章指人为促使两个子群对立。
items.exampleEn: Separate performance targets pitted the service team against the sales team.
items.exampleZh: 相互分离的绩效目标使客服团队与销售团队陷入对立。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 严密控制，足以扼制活动的控制力
items.definitionEn: A tight grip or degree of control that is difficult to escape.
items.usage: 比喻强势控制，常用 a stranglehold on 或 break a stranglehold。
items.exampleEn: The shared database broke one department’s stranglehold on customer records.
items.exampleZh: 共享数据库打破了一个部门对客户记录的严密控制。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 忙乱而紧张的，近乎疯狂的
items.definitionEn: Very fast and energetic in a hurried or uncontrolled way.
items.usage: 常形容 pace 或 activity，带有紧张忙乱的意味。
items.exampleEn: The team worked at a frenetic pace in the days before the launch.
items.exampleZh: 发布前的几天，团队以紧张忙乱的节奏工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 向许多人传播、分发信息
items.definitionEn: To spread information widely among a group of people.
items.usage: 正式用词，常接 information、findings、guidance。
items.exampleEn: The quality team disseminated its findings through a short weekly bulletin.
items.exampleZh: 质控团队通过简短的每周简报向大家传达调查结果。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 积压、堵塞，许多待处理事项堆在一个环节
items.definitionEn: An accumulation that blocks progress or prevents further movement.
items.usage: 常形容审批、谈判或待办事项的堆积，侧重已经堵住的局面。
items.exampleEn: Giving two more supervisors approval authority cleared the logjam.
items.exampleZh: 让另外两名主管拥有审批权限，消除了积压。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 卫星办公室，设在总部之外的小型办公点
items.definitionEn: A smaller office located away from and linked to a main office.
items.usage: 常指覆盖另一个地区的办公点。
items.exampleEn: The firm opened a satellite office near several major clients.
items.exampleZh: 公司在几家重要客户附近设立了一个小型办事处。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 渠道、传递信息的中间人
items.definitionEn: A person or channel through which information or resources pass.
items.usage: 可说 a conduit for information。文章里将跨界联络人比作传递信息的渠道。
items.exampleEn: The regional coordinator served as a conduit for feedback from local stores.
items.exampleZh: 区域协调员负责传递各地门店的反馈。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 关系网络中的间隔度数
items.definitionEn: A link counted as one step along the shortest chain connecting two people in a network.
items.usage: 直接认识是一步，经一个中间人连接是两步。文中用它衡量网络中信息需要跨几道关系。
items.exampleEn: In the new network map, staff in different offices were usually only two degrees of separation apart.
items.exampleZh: 在新的网络图上，不同办公室的员工通常只隔两步就能联系起来。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 收获好处，获得投入带来的回报
items.definitionEn: To gain advantages as a result of an action or investment.
items.usage: reap 本义是收割，这里强调得到此前行动带来的好处。
items.exampleEn: Teams that share testing tools can reap benefits long after the first project ends.
items.exampleZh: 共享测试工具的团队可以在第一个项目结束后继续受益。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 地理上分散且彼此遥远的
items.definitionEn: Spread over a wide area or located a long way away.
items.usage: 常修饰 offices、teams、colleagues 等，强调地域分散。
items.exampleEn: The handbook gave far-flung offices a consistent way to report incidents.
items.exampleZh: 这份手册让分布在各地的办事处可以用统一的方式报告事故。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 及时了解并跟上最新进展
items.definitionEn: To remain informed about recent developments or changes.
items.usage: abreast of 常与 stay、keep 搭配，强调持续掌握动态。
items.exampleEn: A shared update channel helped contractors stay abreast of design changes.
items.exampleZh: 共享更新频道让承包商及时了解设计变更。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 煞费苦心、格外用心地做某事
items.definitionEn: To make a special effort to do something carefully or thoroughly.
items.usage: 原文 great 加强语气。pains 在这条习语中表示用心和努力。
items.exampleEn: The coordinator took pains to give every department a chance to comment.
items.exampleZh: 协调员格外用心，确保每个部门都有机会提出意见。
collocations: take great pains to avoid errors

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 可以舍弃的，被认为没有也行的
items.definitionEn: Considered possible to give up or remove without significant loss.
items.usage: 用来形容员工时，指组织认为失去这名员工也无妨，语气往往带批评。
items.exampleEn: A technician who works quietly may seem expendable until a critical system fails.
items.exampleZh: 一位默默工作的技术员可能被视为可有可无，直到关键系统出了故障。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 技术或专业领域的前沿
items.definitionEn: The most advanced stage of development in a field.
items.usage: 名词搭配 at the cutting edge of。置于名词前作形容词时通常写 cutting-edge。
items.exampleEn: The lab stayed at the cutting edge of battery research by protecting time for experimentation.
items.exampleZh: 实验室保留了用于做实验的时间，因而能保持在电池研究前沿。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 突然袭击，使某人毫无防备地受到冲击
items.definitionEn: To surprise someone with an unexpected and usually unwelcome event.
items.usage: 常用 be blindsided by news 或 a change，通常带意外和不利的意味。
items.exampleEn: The operations team was blindsided by the supplier’s sudden withdrawal.
items.exampleZh: 供应商突然退出，运营团队完全没有预料到。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 临时的，因具体情形而发生或安排的
items.definitionEn: Arranged or occurring for a particular situation rather than as part of a regular plan.
items.usage: 本文指并非按计划发生的临时接触。也常指为特定问题临时组建的委员会。
